data.name: Intajul
data.gender_notes: Intajul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Intajul is a Hindi name which means 'Jewel of the Heart'. It is a beautiful name for a boy which symbolizes the deep love and affection of the parents towards their child. It is a name which signifies the purity, courage, and strength of a boy. The name Intajul carries the meaning “Jewel of the Heart” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Intajul usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel of the heart and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Intajul is a name which is deeply rooted in the spiritual traditions of Hinduism. It is a name which signifies the presence of the divine in the heart of the child. It is a name which is filled with the blessings of the gods and is believed to bring prosperity, success, and happiness to the child and his family.
data.etymology: Intajul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel of the Heart.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Intajul total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
